children: New Delhi, Sept. 11 -- Cochin Shipyard share price today: Shares of Cochin Shipyard Limited, tanked nearly 9% during Friday's trading session after the Miniratna PSU announced its financial year 2026-27 growth guidance. The state-owned shipbuilder has guided for its revenue growth in financial year 2027 to be 12%, whereas its blended EBITDA margin is likely to stabilise at around 14%.
Cochin Shipyard's turnover stood at Rs.1,094.21 crore in June quarter of FY27 against Rs.1,068.50 crore in the previous quarter.

The defence stock has declined 14.38% in 2026 so far, and the recent decline has experienced a major technical breakdown, highlighted Virat Jagad Sr. Technical Research Analyst at Bonanza, suggesting investors to avoid fresh entry as of now.

"Avoid entry now. The stock has experienced a major technical breakdown, slicing through its ascending trendline support and all major Exponential Moving Averages (20, 50, 100, and 200 EMA) around Rs.1,488- Rs.1,524. The heavy volume bar indicates strong institutional distribution, while an RSI dropping rapidly toward 35 confirms weakening momentum without being oversold enough for a mean-reversion bounce. Wait for stability around the Rs.1,300- Rs.1,320 horizontal support zone before considering a fresh position," stated Virat Jagad.

The Kochi-based shipbuilder has current order book of Rs.22,000 crore, which continues to provide the company with good revenue visibility. The defence PSU has also been declared as the lowest bidder for a fine number of next-generation survey vessels for the Indian navy, which is valued at approximately Rs.5,000 crores. Cochin Shipyard's order book is estimated to grow to Rs.27,000 crore after the conclusion of this current contract.

The stock was trading 8.88% lower at Rs.1389.5 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of Rs.36,555.07 crore at 1:57 pm on Friday, September 11. The stock had touched an intraday high of Rs.1,512 per share and an intraday low of Rs.1,380.65 per share. The stock has a return on equity (ROE) of 11.12%. Its share price value has declined 4.9% in six months and around 14.38% in 2026 so far. The company scrip has declined around 15.86% in one year.
